purpose_note: This page states what the current evidence suggests will keep happening if nothing changes. Every entry is a reasoned judgement, not a proven fact and not a measured probability. Confidence is described in plain terms and every entry states what specific new evidence would revise it. Reads across DFAPTA-AR-001 through AR-009 and Lattice Atlas LP-001 through LP-008 against the register frozen at EV-0001-EV-0023 (DEC-0006).

assessments.statement: Absent a change of instrument, Bellbrook will remain without a completed or draft Camp Management Plan.
assessments.basis: Council's own most recent account of its activity (EV-0004, 18 March 2026) describes correspondence, meetings, monitoring and a funding intention, but no commitment to producing the plan itself - the specific instrument AR-001 identifies as the actual grant-access mechanism. No document in this case's register commits Council to starting one.
assessments.confidence_note: Not rated Well-supported: unlike a case built on prolonged institutional silence, this council remains visibly, recently active on this matter - genuine uncertainty exists about whether that activity converts into the specific instrument in the near term.
assessments.would_revise_this: Council formally committing to develop a Bellbrook-specific plan, or commencing one, in any documented form.

assessments.statement: NSW Government flying-fox camp management grant funding will remain unavailable to Bellbrook for as long as no plan exists.
assessments.basis: Directly conditioned on TPA-001 and AR-001 - the plan is described as the funding precondition. Not a separate uncertain judgement once TPA-001 holds.
assessments.confidence_note: The underlying plan-gating claim itself rests on operator-supplied fact sheets, not the program's own published guidelines (Q-0002 open) - one notch below Well-supported until that primary source is confirmed.
assessments.would_revise_this: Confirmation of the program's actual eligibility guidelines (Q-0002), or the plan itself being produced (see TPA-001).

assessments.statement: The camp will remain outside the Commonwealth's operational monitoring scope regardless of any further registration attempt, unless the National Flying Fox Monitoring Program's federal funding resumes.
assessments.basis: DCCEEW's own written reply (EV-0023) states the program was paused in 2022 due to a cessation of federal funding and the Department cannot currently send resources to survey any camp under it - a direct institutional statement, not an inference.
assessments.confidence_note: Grounded directly in a primary institutional source responding to this case's own registration attempt - the strongest-evidenced projection in this set.
assessments.would_revise_this: Confirmation that federal funding for the NFFMP has resumed, or that the camp meets the EPBC Act's 'nationally important camp' threshold triggering a referral obligation regardless of the pause (see Q-0011).

assessments.statement: The specific resolution numbers, 9/0 vote count and defeated 2/7 amendment claimed for the 20 May 2025 meeting (EV-0010) will remain unconfirmed unless the signed minutes are directly obtained.
assessments.basis: No document in this case, including the one independently-fetched source (EV-0001), corroborates these specific figures. Both the council's and web.archive.org's sites have blocked automated fetch attempts across this case's runs.
assessments.confidence_note: A direct continuation of a documented absence with no intervening variable - the gap does not close on its own without a specific action.
assessments.would_revise_this: Direct sighting of the signed confirmed minutes, via manual browser access or a GIPA/formal records request (DR-001).

assessments.statement: If a GIPA or formal records request for the 20 May 2025 signed minutes is lodged, CTR-0001 would very likely resolve on primary evidence.
assessments.basis: Council holds a statutory obligation to maintain and, on request, disclose confirmed meeting minutes - a records mechanism distinct from the blocked automated web-fetch route this case has relied on so far.
assessments.confidence_note: Conditional: the mechanism exists and is reliable in principle, but this case has not yet tested it, and response timeframes and redactions are not accounted for.
assessments.would_revise_this: A lodged request and Council's actual response.

assessments.statement: If Kempsey Shire Council commences a Bellbrook-specific Camp Management Plan referencing its own Rudder Park precedent, grant eligibility becomes reachable without any change to NSW program rules.
assessments.basis: The Rudder Park precedent (EV-0002) demonstrates this exact council already operates this exact mechanism successfully within the same shire; Mount Isa's DETSI-funded plan development (EV-0021) demonstrates funding exists specifically for the development step itself, not only implementation.
assessments.confidence_note: Conditional on a council decision this case cannot itself produce - the precedent shows the pathway is executable, not that Council will choose to execute it for Bellbrook.
assessments.would_revise_this: Council formally commencing plan development for Bellbrook, in any documented form.

assessments.statement: If Council's current flying-fox webpage is directly, manually sighted and its full text captured, CTR-0002 would very likely be substantially narrowed.
assessments.basis: The page has only blocked automated fetch (HTTP 403); nothing in this case's register indicates manual browser access is restricted. A direct capture would confirm or correct the 'historic' classification, the Rudder Park comparison, and the private/Crown land management claims in one action (DR-002).
assessments.confidence_note: Narrowing the classification question does not by itself resolve whether the colony returned after its confirmed 2021 departure (Q-0008) - a second, independent question this single action would not settle.
assessments.would_revise_this: A dated, directly-sighted capture of the page's current full text.

not_claimed: No entry above is a prediction of what will happen by a specific date.
No entry above is a measured probability - the confidence labels are qualitative judgements about how well-supported the pattern is, not statistics.
None of these assessments authorise or compel any action by any institution. They describe what this investigation expects to keep happening if nothing changes, nothing more.

No entry above assumes bad faith on the part of Kempsey Shire Council, the Commonwealth Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water, or any individual officer - each projects institutional behaviour patterns already visible in the frozen register, not motive.

Local Health Incidence was assessed and excluded: whether any Bellbrook resident has experienced histoplasmosis or an ABLV exposure is indeterminate from the frozen register - no site-specific incidence evidence exists either way (Q-0006, Q-0010).
June 2026 Severity Report Content was assessed and excluded: this case has not located the report referenced in EV-0015, so no forward judgement is made about what it would show if found (Q-0009).

Response to the Four Drafted Submissions was assessed and excluded: whether council, the Ombudsman, or elected representatives respond to the drafted materials (EV-0006, EV-0007) if lodged is inference about individual institutional behaviour this case's register does not yet support (Q-0005).
